body:
Hi @jfrueh this is currently not doable indeed. But that is definitely one of the main aspects of IS we are currently working on: provide full control of the markup and events given a widget, in an easy way.

We will get there ultimately but for now to do what you want, you will have to build custom widgets.

See https://github.com/algolia/instantsearch.js/issues/868#issuecomment-188206988 for a detailed explanation on doing a custom widget, you will have to tune it to do a refinement list and you will have to understand the helper for now.

I am sorry this currently does not fits your need for now, thanks for all the feedback!
